en.hubeali: H 14620 – Ali, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al-Fazl Bin Shazaan altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abd Al-Rahmaan Bin Al-Hajjaaj, and Hafs Bin Al-Bakhtary, and Salmat Bayya Al-Sabiry, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:

‘Whenever Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> used to take the Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup>, he<sup>asws</sup> would look into it and say: ‘Who can endure this, who can endure this?’ Then he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Who would act upon it, and when he<sup>asws</sup> would stand for the Prayer, his<sup>asws</sup> colour would change to the extent that it would become apparent in his<sup>asws</sup> face, and no one can endure the actions of Ali<sup>asws</sup> from his<sup>asws</sup> sons<sup>asws</sup> from after him<sup>asws</sup> except for Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 172. Ali, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al-Fazl Bin Shazaan altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abd Al-Rahmaan Bin Al-Hajjaaj, and Hafs Bin Al-Bakhtary, and Salmat Bayya Al-Sabiry, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullah (a.s.) said:

‘Whenever Ali (a.s.) Bin Al-Husayn (a.s.) used to take the Book of Ali (a.s.), he (a.s.) would look into it and say: ‘Who can endure this, who can endure this?’ Then he (a.s.) said: ‘Who would act upon it, and when he (a.s.) would stand for the Prayer, his (a.s.) colour would change to the extent that it would become apparent in his (a.s.) face, and no one can endure the actions of Ali (a.s.) from his (a.s.) sons (a.s.) from after him (a.s.) except for Ali (a.s.) Bin Al-Husayn (a.s.)’.
